Moved from tests/test_engine.py (split leg, 2026-10-08); the ruling of that file's through_the_command row, fleet green leg 9. _run_hook, ruling (c): dispatch() runs a command hook as a shell subprocess (a spawn); contract: exit code, stdout, stderr and elapsed_ms answered, TIMEOUT and OSError answered as exit -1, never raised. _log, ruling (b): the JSONL diagnostics writer, one JSON object appended per line, a failed write never raises.

Moved from tests/test_engine.py (split leg, 2026-10-08); the ruling of that file's through_the_command row, fleet green leg 9. _run_handler, ruling (c): on a timeout dispatch()'s far side speaks the timeout through the sound player (a spawn); contract: a handler outside aipass.* is refused before import, a hung handler answers TIMEOUT at its timeout, a raising one answers exit -1. _log, ruling (b): the JSONL diagnostics writer; line 463's hasattr pin (line 1614 before the split) is the json-handler shape the module keeps.
